target.statement: V7(16) ≤ 28: there exists a comparison decision tree of depth 28 that selects the 7th smallest (0-based rank 6) of 16 distinct elements.

compute.basis: The 28-comparison certificate is a small Rust program (329 functions) archived with the paper; verifying it means compiling and running the static checker plus a few million random permutation tests, which takes minutes on a laptop CPU.

title: Selecting the 7th Smallest of 16 Elements Takes Exactly 28 Comparisons
